resources.string: Only nonblank plain text up to 4,096 characters is supported. Attachments, HTML and multiple items are not opened. Nothing was imported.
Shared content is untrusted text, not instructions. Links are not opened or fetched. Review it before importing.

Import replaces the destination tool’s inputs and selected text mode, including any restored draft. If you switch from a different tool, its normal non-password draft is kept. Cancel leaves your tools unchanged.
After you confirm, Text Tools and Morse perform their normal live conversion. QR and Hash wait for Generate. Choosing a destination alone does not import.

The initial import is not added to automatic history or remembered results. Later edits or Generate can be saved under your settings; manual Workbench saves are separate. After import, normal Android task drafts can survive recreation. This preview itself is discarded on rotation or restart.
